summary.text: Tricia Cotham is a Republican member of the North Carolina House of Representatives from District 105 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A former teacher, she previously served in the House from 2007 to 2016 and returned in 2023; she announced in April 2023 that she was leaving the Democratic Party to register as a Republican.

paragraphs.text: Tricia Cotham earned a B.A. in history from the University of North Carolina at Charlotte and a master's degree in school administration from the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill.
Her professional experience includes working as a teacher, assistant principal, and athletic coach in Charlotte-Mecklenburg Schools.
Cotham first served in the North Carolina House from 2007 to 2016, representing District 100.
On April 5, 2023, she announced that she was leaving the Democratic Party and would register as a Republican.
At a news conference she said, "The modern-day Democratic Party has become unrecognizable to me and to so many others throughout this state and this country."
Ballotpedia notes that the switch gave Republicans a supermajority in the House.
